intro: Use this guide to check what you already have and make a rough budget for anything missing.
creed: You don't need perfect. You need prepared. Your equipment doesn't define your skill, but being prepared shows your client you're professional.
pricingNote: Every ₱ range on this page is a rounded planning allowance, not a quote, a market survey, or proof that an item will suit your work. The checker total adds the low end of each one-time range you have not checked off and leaves out monthly services. The official references below support the sizing advice, not every price shown. Used condition, promos, warranty, address-specific internet offers, and local stock move the real cost, so confirm the exact model and the requirements of your own software before paying.

categories.name: Laptop / Computer
categories.note: Start with the requirements for your actual apps. RAM, storage, battery condition, and ports can matter more than the model badge.

tiers.item: Used or refurbished business laptop; inspect and test it
New mid-range laptop that meets your app requirements
Laptop configured for your design, video, or development tools

categories.name: Internet Connection
categories.note: Check upload performance, peak-hour stability, household sharing, and the requirements of your calling app. Offers depend on your address.

tiers.item: Prepaid pocket WiFi or mobile-data failover; data costs extra
Home fiber plan; compare offers available at your address
Primary fiber plus a separate mobile or ISP backup

categories.name: Power Backup
categories.note: Size backup power from the watts your devices draw and the runtime you need. VA or watt-hours alone do not promise a specific runtime.

tiers.item: Entry UPS sized for your router and computer load
Compact power station; verify output and load-specific runtime
Larger power station sized from measured load and target runtime

categories.name: Headset
categories.note: Choose a microphone that stays clear in the room where you work. Test it with your normal background noise.

tiers.item: Wired USB headset with boom mic
USB headset with a noise-reducing microphone
Higher-end headset or dedicated USB microphone

categories.name: Webcam
categories.note: Most laptop cams are fine to start. Upgrade for client-facing roles.

tiers.item: Built-in laptop camera
External webcam; test it in your lighting
Webcam plus an adjustable light

categories.name: Second Monitor
categories.note: A second screen can reduce window switching once you are working. It is not needed to start.

tiers.item: Used monitor; inspect the panel and ports
New monitor with the size and ports you need
Larger or higher-resolution monitor for specialist work

categories.name: Ergonomic Setup
categories.note: Comfort and fit depend on your body, desk, and working position. Adjust what you own before buying replacements.

tiers.item: Laptop riser, cushion, and external keyboard as needed
Adjustable office chair that you can try first
Adjustable chair and desk chosen for fit

categories.name: Focus Lighting
categories.note: A task light can make late shifts easier to work through. Aim it at the desk and adjust it so the screen is not the only bright surface in the room.

tiers.item: Adjustable LED desk lamp
Desk lamp plus a soft light behind the monitor
Monitor light bar plus adjustable room lighting

builds.name: The Starter
builds.desc: Example only: used laptop, wired headset, backup-data device, and a load-sized UPS.
builds.for: A starting budget to test against current local offers.

builds.name: The Standard
builds.desc: Example only: new mid-range laptop, home fiber, clearer audio, webcam, and compact backup power.
builds.for: Check every item against your workload before buying.

builds.name: The Pro
builds.desc: Example only: specialist laptop, second monitor, higher-end audio, larger backup power, and adjustable furniture.
builds.for: For workloads that have already proved they need the extra capacity.
